recentItems.title: How a South Florida tea shop is helping a family matriarch retire
recentItems.description:
As inflation pushes up the cost of everyday necessities, millions of Americans are looking for ways to bring in extra money, and one South Florida family turned a desire to help its matriarch retire into a growing tea business.

Natacha Armbrister is the owner of High 7 Teas, a family-run Hollywood business involving three generations of women. Armbrister works full time at a hospital while spending her free time building the company she started about a decade ago.
